title: Use Specific Id Param Types in Grasshopper Components
description: All Grasshopper component parameters must use the most specific param type possible. ID inputs must use the proper IdParam type (not AddTextParameter). Casts must exist so that e.g. a Design input auto-casts to DesignId by selecting the guid. Fix all components: FileComponent (Folder→FolderIdParam), QualityComponent (Folder→FolderIdParam), TypeComponent (Folder→FolderIdParam), DesignComponent (Folder→FolderIdParam), ModelComponent (FileGuid→FileIdParam, TagGuids→TagIdParam). Also ensure all IdGoo types have proper cast from their entity Goo (entity→id extracts guid). Also ensure all entity Goo have CastTo their IdGoo.
summary: Changed all Grasshopper component parameters to use the most specific ID param types. FileComponent.Folder (FolderId?) now uses FolderIdParam. FolderComponent.Parent (string guid) now uses FolderIdParam. ModelComponent.FileGuid→FileIdParam and TagGuids→TagIdParam. Added bidirectional casts: FileGoo↔FileIdGoo, FolderGoo→FolderIdGoo, TagGoo→TagIdGoo. Build passes with 0 errors.
